correctness.rationale: Exact repeated-measurement dynamics is P_(T/m)^m, where P is unistochastic and circulant. Even-cycle chiral-sublattice conjugation makes P reciprocal exactly. Odd-cycle first counter-winding interference at walk lengths 1 and n-1 yields 4(-1)^((n-1)/2)J^n sin(Phi) delta^n/(n-1)! in the oriented one-step contrast. Since P-I=O(delta^2), a telescoping matrix-power difference multiplies the leading antisymmetric term by m with controlled O(m^2 delta^(n+2)) remainder; hence A_m=4(-1)^((n-1)/2) J^n T^n sin(Phi)/((n-1)!m^(n-1))+O(m^(-n)). Escape E_m=2J^2T^2/m+O(m^-2). Gauge-real fluxes sin(Phi)=0 imply exact zero. Independently built Hermitian ring matrices and exponentiated them for n=3,5,7,8; asymptotic coefficients and even exact reciprocity checked numerically. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, the path/winding proof.
residual_risks: Uniformity for growing ring n or simultaneous T,J scaling is not proved.
